claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
Advanced CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, connecting enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows with evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration from intake through production monitoring.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
